title: Rockwall Property Data Profile
eyebrow: Rockwall Central Appraisal District · PACS appraisal export files
intro: Everything in Rockwall CAD's 2026 PACS Appraisal Export, downloaded from the CAD website: 20 files per export, in four snapshots — the preliminary rolls exported March 16 and May 26, the certified roll exported July 13 and supplement 6 exported October 9. The year switch on every tab picks the snapshot. For each file you get its columns, data types, completeness and value distributions.
foot: Generated {date}. Files were scanned in full with DuckDB from the gzipped CSVs that etl/rockwall_appraisal_export_etl.py writes from the raw PACS .TXT files, using Denton's 8.0.30 layout (Rockwall publishes the same PACS export; fields added in 8.0.32 and 8.0.33 stay in unmapped_tail); "Auto-detected on load" is the type DuckDB assigns, and distinct counts there are approximate (HyperLogLog). "Data type" is inferred from the values: Code means digits stored as text with leading zeros.
